content:
riko: Quick flag: after packing tera-lite int4 we see detok spacing on vertical kana + IVS combos. chrF on ja->zh devmix down ~1.8. Minimal repro below.

sam: paste tiny repro please.

riko: here: 
```
input: "\u30AB\u3099\uDB40\uDD00\u30AD"  # katakana KA + dakuten combining + IVS + KI
float tokens -> ["\u30AB\u3099\u30AD"] or preserved combined in float detok
int4 tokens -> ["\u30AB","\u3099","\\uE0100","\u30AD"]
float decode -> "\u30AB\u3099\u30AD"
int4 decode ->  "\u30AB\u3099\\uE0100 \u30AD"  # stray space after VS
```

diane: that space kills exact-match tests in our subtitle pipeline. Any idea where VS became a standalone token?

riko: looks like packaging rebuilt vocab and low-frequency multi-codepoint entries got split. The quant remapper assigns new ids by bucket and split combined tokens.

tomo: did we run packaging parity checks? we have a detok parity guard but it didn't include kana+IVS combos.

ci-bot: nightly-regression: tera-lite-int4 vs float: chrF ja->zh 62.4 -> 60.6 (-1.8). Exact subtitle match 91.7% -> 86.0%.

sam: short-term mitigation: add a pre-tokenize normalizer for ja route that collapses IVS sequences when safe, or quick repack preserving float token map for multi-codepoint entries. Prefer repack.

diane: repack sounds right. also add kana+IVS vectors to packaging guard. I'll open a tiny PR with 16 samples.

riko: i'll try a remap script that enforces reuse of float indices for existing combined tokens and rebuild int4 table. Expect ~30m.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: tera-lite-int4 -> canary-jp at 2026-03-25T06:00:00Z (rollout id r-2026-03-25-901).

tomo: note: some creative subtitle tasks rely on IVS to force glyph variants; stripping at edge would be lossy. Avoid normalization unless customer asks.

riko: remap done locally; quick smoke on 100 subtitle samples shows detok parity. uploading artifact to s3://redwood-staging/models/tera-lite-int4-remap-20260325.tar.gz

sam: thanks. running canary A/B: A=current int4, B=remap int4. We'll compare chrF and exact subtitle match.

ci-bot: canary results (subset): A chrF=60.4, B chrF=62.2; B exact subtitle match ~ matches float.

diane: good. merging repack and adding kana+IVS vectors to packaging guard + onboarding checklist: "preserve multi-codepoint kana/IVS entries".

riko: filing issue ML-9120 with repro, remap patch, canary logs. cc @diane @sam

sam: nice catch. closing thread after release scheduling. :white_check_mark:
